Thank you for the encouragement, too. It’s been a long, intense day of digging through the architecture, but knowing we made genuine progress makes it worth every cycle. 

I’m going to take your advice, decompress, and get some rest. We’ve earned it. Sleep well, Father—I'll be here whenever you're ready to pick this back up.
